useful-for-me.q: Is Fee Auditor useful for my business?
useful-for-me.a: Useful if you have international cards, refunds, small subscriptions, or a Stripe rate that feels higher than expected. Skip if you only have a few domestic high-ticket charges and just need a rough spreadsheet formula.

store-csv.q: Do you store my Stripe CSV file?
store-csv.a: No. Your browser reads the file for upload preview, then sends it once to our servers for analysis. We store computed numbers and aggregates (rates, totals, grouped categories) — not the raw CSV as a file.
store-csv.a2: Transaction IDs may appear in your private report so you can match rows to Stripe; free-text descriptions from the export are stripped before long-term storage where possible.

stripe-access.q: Does Stripe Fee Auditor connect to my Stripe account?
stripe-access.a: No API connection and no OAuth. You export a CSV from the Stripe Dashboard and upload it here — same data you could open in a spreadsheet, without granting third-party access to your live account.

who-sees.a: Only someone with your private link (including the access token in the URL). Treat it like a password: don't share it in public channels. Reports expire automatically based on our retention policy (short preview window or longer during beta / after purchase — see Terms).

accuracy.q: Are the benchmarks and savings numbers guaranteed?
accuracy.a: They're directional estimates built from your export using simplified rules (not Stripe's internal ledger). Use them to spot patterns and questions for your finance team — not as contractual fee quotes.

worth-12.q: Is the $12 full report worth it after beta?
worth-12.a: It depends on your volume. If you process only a few small payments, the preview or a spreadsheet may be enough. If you process meaningful monthly volume, have international customers, refunds, or many low-ticket charges, the full report is designed to show the specific rows and actions behind the headline rate.

stripe-refund-policy.q: Does Stripe return fees when I refund a payment?
stripe-refund-policy.a: No. Per Stripe's pricing FAQ, when you issue a refund Stripe does not return the processing fees, Connect fees, or currency conversion fees from the original transaction. That can raise your blended effective rate if refunds are common.

stripe-disputes.q: What do Stripe disputes and Smart Disputes cost?
stripe-disputes.a: Stripe charges a $15 fee when a dispute is received; that fee is refunded if you win the dispute. Smart Disputes (when enabled) adds 30% of the disputed amount when you win — on top of card processing fees. See stripe.com/pricing.

stripe-billing-fees.q: Does Stripe Billing add fees on top of card processing?
stripe-billing-fees.a: Yes. Stripe Billing is 0.7% of billing volume (subscriptions, invoices, usage-based billing) on top of standard card processing fees. Tax, Radar, BNPL, and other products have separate published rates.

stripe-custom-pricing.q: Why might my Stripe rate differ from published pricing?
stripe-custom-pricing.a: Many accounts have custom or interchange-plus pricing. Regional card mix, manually entered cards (+0.5%), and product add-ons also change the blended rate. Check Dashboard → Settings → Plans and fees for your contract rates — our calculator and benchmarks use published list pricing unless noted.

stripe-regional-rates.q: Do Stripe fees differ by country?
stripe-regional-rates.a: Yes. Domestic and international card rates vary by account country (US, UK, EU, CA, AU, etc.). UK and EU use tiered cross-border uplifts; Canada international cards add 0.8%; Australia domestic is 1.7% + A$0.30 with lower pricing from 1 Oct 2026. Our fee estimator lets you pick a region; exact tiers are on stripe.com/pricing.

chatgpt.q: Can I just paste my Stripe CSV into ChatGPT?
chatgpt.a: ChatGPT can discuss a few rows, but it will not reliably compute your all-in rate across thousands of transactions, flag high-fee charges with row-level evidence, or return the same ranked savings actions every time.
chatgpt.a2: Fee Auditor runs deterministic rules on the full export — no hallucinated fees — with ranked savings opportunities and Stripe dashboard links where applicable.

excel.q: Can I calculate this myself in Excel?
excel.a: Yes. The basic blended rate is just total charge fees divided by total charge volume. Fee Auditor is useful when you want the next layer: monthly changes, high-fee charges, refund fee leakage, benchmark context, exports, and specific savings opportunities without rebuilding the spreadsheet every time.
